description: facade of a long low Bronze Age Greek storehouse and armoury seen from directly in front, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Walls of warm pale limestone ashlar blocks with a FLAT roof slab and a straight stone cornice across the top. Two tall wooden double doors of vertical planks with heavy iron bands, and narrow shuttered openings between them. Plain and workmanlike, no columns. The whole facade is drawn small enough that the left end and the right end are both complete and visible. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the building.
